referenceSources.description:
A white Porsche 911 GT1, adorned with Mobil and IBM logos and sporting the number 26, navigates a sweeping corner at the Circuit des 24 Heures du Mans. Its sleek aerodynamic body, large rear wing, and gold wheels highlight the factory GT1 design that achieved a 1–2 finish in the 1998 race.

Blue and yellow kerbs line the edge of the asphalt under a cloudy sky, while the LE MANS.org and ACO emblems reinforce the setting. Photo credit ACO/Nikon captures the car’s dynamic motion and historic livery during one of Porsche’s most celebrated endurance victories.
